blocked.command: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile -t opl-cloud-candidate:92de4458-amd64 --load <sha-tree>
blocked.evidence: Docker Hub DNS is unresolvable in this environment (docker manifest inspect node:26-bookworm-slim and docker:29.8.1-cli both fail with 'dial tcp: lookup registry-1.docker.io: no such host'; the buildx run fails at the docker:29.8.1-cli base with 'dial tcp: lookup auth.docker.io: no such host'). Four of the five pinned Dockerfile bases (golang:1.26-bookworm, golang:1.25-bookworm, node:26-bookworm-slim) are already present in the local image store by digest, but docker:29.8.1-cli is not, so the multi-stage build cannot complete. This is an environmental blocker for the local image build only; the Candidate workflow builds from an exact checked-out SHA on GitHub-hosted runners with no local Docker dependency.

notRun: No Candidate image was pushed: .github/workflows/build-opl-cloud-candidate.yml admits only github.actor == github.repository_owner and github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner (gaofeng21cn); the serial window's actor is not that owner. No Instance deployment, Tencent resource action, real charge or production access was performed. No digest was fabricated.
